about_the_game:
✨ About This Game

Relax Scramble is a cozy, endless word puzzle game designed for calm minds and clever players.

There are no time limits, no pressure — just a soothing flow of falling letters. Select and combine them into words, earn points, and watch the board gently refill itself with new possibilities.

Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or gently train your vocabulary, Relax Scramble offers a minimal, meditative experience where progress is as slow or fast as you like.

🌿 Features:

  • 🧩 Endless gameplay — no game over, just pure word crafting

  • ✍️ Build words freely from a grid of shifting letters

  • 🎧 Relaxing music and sound design for a cozy atmosphere

  • 🧠 Great for all ages and skill levels

  • 💾 Cloud saves to keep your progress across devices

If you love games like Wordament, SpellTower, or Letter Quest — but always wished they were more relaxing — this is your perfect escape.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+ / 10 / 11
  • Processor: 1.8 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Designed to run on low-spec systems
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz dual-core
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GT 1030 or better)
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced with headphones and a cup of tea ☕
